#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Eval remaining suites in a single process to avoid cron monitor false alarms.

Usage:
    python run_all_suites_eval.py <model_path> <gpu_id> <suite_list> <output_dir>

Examples:
    python run_all_suites_eval.py lerobot/smolvla_libero 1 "libero_object libero_goal libero_10" /root/acib/outputs/baseline_std_v3
    python run_all_suites_eval.py lerobot/smolvla_libero_plus 0 "libero_object libero_goal libero_10" /root/acib/outputs/baseline_plus_v2
"""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime


def ts():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 5:
        print(f"Usage: {sys.argv[0]} <model_path> <gpu_id> <suite_list> <output_dir>")
        sys.exit(1)

    model_path = sys.argv[1]
    gpu_id = sys.argv[2]
    suite_list = sys.argv[3].split()
    output_dir = sys.argv[4]

    os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = gpu_id
    os.environ["HF_HOME"] = "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache"
    os.environ["REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE"] = "/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"
    os.environ["SSL_CERT_FILE"] = "/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"
    os.environ["HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET"] = "1"
    os.environ["MUJOCO_GL"] = "egl"
    os.environ["PYOPENGL_PLATFORM"] = "egl"

    rename_map = '{"observation.images.image": "observation.images.camera1", "observation.images.image2": "observation.images.camera2"}'

    print(f"{ts()} Starting eval")
    print(f"  Model: {model_path}")
    print(f"  GPU: {gpu_id}")
    print(f"  Suites: {' '.join(suite_list)}")
    print(f"  Output: {output_dir}")
    print(f"  PID: {os.getpid()}")
    sys.stdout.flush()

    os.chdir("/root/acib")

    for suite in suite_list:
        print(f"{ts()} === Starting suite: {suite} ===")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        subprocess.run([
            "lerobot-eval",
            f"--policy.path={model_path}",
            "--env.type=libero",
            f"--env.task={suite}",
            "--eval.n_episodes=50",
            "--eval.batch_size=1",
            "--env.max_parallel_tasks=1",
            "--policy.empty_cameras=1",
            f"--rename_map={rename_map}",
            f"--output_dir={output_dir}/{suite}",
        ], check=True)
        print(f"{ts()} === Finished suite: {suite} ===")
        sys.stdout.flush()

    print(f"{ts()} All suites completed.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
